meta.phase-name: Generated Registry And Dialogue Presentation Consolidation

phase-summary.outcome: Canonical content-pack registry metadata is now generated in TS/C++/C# instead of hand-authored in `contracts/index.ts`; `spaceVectors` and `presenterStrings` are no longer canonical registry/editor packs; presenter/feed text now lives under `dialoguePack.presenterStrings`; and the engine/docs-site/KAPLAY type surfaces are aligned to that contract shape.

artifacts.artifact: Dialogue pack now owns presenter strings.
Workflow and canonical/internal pack conventions updated.

gaps.gap: The Payload `content-editor:bootstrap --publish` path still hits an existing dev-schema drift/constraint-drop error in Postgres/Payload migration flow; this slice did not repair that DB migration issue.

`vectorRuntime` / `config_space_vectors.json` still exist as internal semantic-runtime inputs for Space Explorer and room semantic systems; the public/editorial registry no longer treats them as canonical packs, but the deeper taxonomy rename remains future work.
